changelog:
v4.0.0 Major Overhaul:
• Fixed Direct In-App APK Downloader & Installer (no browser redirect, zero package conflict).
• Fixed Lock Mode touch blockage staying 100% active when toggle is hidden.
• Added Instant Free Fire & Landscape Auto-Activation.
• Added 6 Independent Zones with full In-Game Control Menu to toggle/exclude individual blocks and fine-tune dimensions directly inside the game.
